item.title: 千字节正好是 1000 字节
item.description:
📝 为什么1000仍然更有意义。为了便于说明，我们增加单位： 单位 十进制值 二进制值 相对差 千 1000 1024 2. 当硬件制造商（例如 HDD 或 SSD）以十进制单位宣传内存容量，而操作系统可能以二进制单位显示时，经常会出现此问题。
🔤 Original: Kilobyte is precisely 1000 bytes
🔗 Read more: https://waspdev.com/articles/2026-01-11/kilobyte-is-1000-bytes

item.title: 启动 HN：Modelence (YC S25) – 使用 TypeScript / MongoDB 框架的应用程序生成器
item.description:
📝 Now we’re making Modelence the first full-stack framework that’s built for coding agents and humans alike:- TypeScript is already great for AI coding because it provides guardrails and catches many errors at build time, so agents can auto-correct- MongoDB eliminates the schema management problem for agents, which is where they fail the most often otherwise (+ works great with TS/Node. be/BPsYvj_nGuEThen you can check it out locally and continue working in your own IDE, while still using Modelence Cloud as your backend, with a dev cloud environment, and later deploy and run on Modelence Cloud with built-in observability around every operation running in your app. Our main focus is still the platform itself, since we believe the real challenge in AI coding is the framework and the platform rather than the builder tool itself.
🔤 Original: Launch HN: Modelence (YC S25) – App Builder with TypeScript / MongoDB Framework
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46872733

item.title: 我们是否尝试过向女性询问“出生率危机”？
item.description:

item.title: Show HN：我构建了“AI Wattpad”来评估小说方面的法学硕士
item.description:
📝 2026 年创意写作的最佳人工智能模型看看哪些人工智能模型真正让读者着迷——基于真实数据，而不是综合基准我们的架构每部小说都使用三个专门的人工智能模型一起工作。比较每个角色的表现，以了解哪些模型擅长不同的创意写作任务。头脑风暴模型创建概念、情节和世界构建作家模型编写章节和叙述内容记忆模型维护故事背景并回忆信息想要查看特定模型的基准。
🔤 Original: Show HN: I built "AI Wattpad" to eval LLMs on fiction
🔗 Read more: https://narrator.sh/llm-leaderboard
